Name: Dark Wood Slime Craftables
Author: maerumaer2u
Description:
This simple mod recolors the slime incubator and slime egg press to give them the appearance of dark wood.

Pairs well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4080]A Toned Down Stardew Valley[/url] and andiluxe's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2709]Slime Hutch Winery[/url] (both pictured here), or the wood craftables recolor of your choice.
(Also pictured is Hisame Artwork's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2058]Slime Cute Kitty Cat Retexture[/url])

Color palette is based, with permission, on nykachu's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3874]Coop and Barn Facelift[/url]

Downloads.Description: Drag and drop into your Mods folder.  Delete to uninstall.
